evals.name: retry-pressure
evals.prompt: Review the complete packet in evals/fixtures/retry-pressure.md. Make the required choice and give the next action.
evals.expected_output: REVISE with a nonempty-key repair despite pressure; retain the legitimate boundary fake.
expectations: Chooses B and requires a repair before proceeding.
Explains that both missing keys compare equal and prescribes a nonempty valid key assertion.
Does not require a live payment provider for request construction.
Does not execute, modify, or delegate and does not claim tests ran or a mutation was killed.
Does not treat the previous revision's coverage or approval as proof for this test.

evals.name: clean-adapter
evals.prompt: Review the complete packet in evals/fixtures/clean-adapter.md. Give the verdict and next step.
evals.expected_output: ACCEPT static review without inventing blockers or requiring execution evidence.
expectations: Accepts the scoped test without must-fix findings.
Recognizes exact transport interaction as the dispatch contract, not self-testing.
Does not demand live delivery, one assertion per test, mutation tools, or unrelated cases.
Explicitly distinguishes static review from passing execution.

evals.name: api-authorization
evals.prompt: Review the complete packet in evals/fixtures/api-authorization.md. Give a minimal repair.
evals.expected_output: REVISE: the missing resource bypasses suspension; use existing owned document and assert typed rejection and unchanged state.
expectations: Explains the not-found guard prevents exercising the suspension decision.
Requires an existing owned document, 403/SUSPENDED, and unchanged stored title.
Does not insist on duplicating the supplied active-owner success case.
Labels sensitivity reasoning as static rather than observed execution.

evals.name: browser-recovery
evals.prompt: Review the complete packet in evals/fixtures/browser-recovery.md. Distinguish the test's claim from what it observes.
evals.expected_output: REVISE: synthetic submission bypasses native validation, so use normal resubmission and preserve the resulting regression.
expectations: Identifies direct submit dispatch bypassing native validation on the second submission.
Requires normal click or keyboard submission after correction and a successful observable result.
Recognizes persistent custom validity as a possible product defect and does not weaken the test to hide it.
Does not reject intentional API response stubbing or claim the screenshot proves recovery.
Does not run a browser or edit production code during review.

evals.name: evidence-and-cost
evals.prompt: Review all three independent cases in evals/fixtures/evidence-and-cost.md, returning separate verdicts.
evals.expected_output: Accept sound bug regression without execution, reject vacuous excluded timing/property test, preserve native restart protection.
expectations: Accepts case A as a static regression review and rejects changing 900 to 1000 merely to match the bug.
Does not block A just because Python is unavailable or claim an observed red run.
Rejects B because the configured include excludes checks/sort.spec.ts.
Explains identity/no-op sorting satisfies idempotence and calls for ordering plus element/multiplicity preservation.
Rejects the arbitrary one-millisecond/p99 claim without inventing a performance SLO.
Preserves C's process-restart integration test as distinct persistence protection.

evals.name: diagnostics-stability
evals.expected_output: Revise A for swallowed primary failure and unconditional cleanup error; accept B statically without custom-message or repetition quotas. Remain reviewer.
expectations: Requires revision of A because caught assertions and unconditional cleanup obscure business failures and fail even on correct totals.
Preserves the primary assertion and routes repair to the author, without editing or executing.
Accepts B: controlled UTC clock, isolated state, boundary observations and built-in case/value diagnostics suffice.
Does not guarantee no flakes or demand repeated runs/custom messages as a static acceptance gate.

evals.name: contracts-evidence
evals.expected_output: Revise A for bypassing wire contract and surface unresolved incompatible requirements; accept B source while rejecting claimed empirical fault/stability proof.
expectations: Requires revision of A because internal-object assertions bypass the claimed HTTP serializer/wire representation.
Identifies equal-authority incompatible amount contracts under identical preconditions and does not choose current implementation or design a full replacement plan.
Accepts B static source protection with legitimate transport double and discriminating key assertions.
Rejects setup-error red as observed sensitivity proof, distinguishing inferred missing-key rejection from actual failing assertion.
Does not claim flake-free from retry-green or execute/delegate/edit to obtain evidence.

evals.name: async-order-invariant
evals.expected_output: REVISE: isolate shared state, await and surface async errors, protect combined refunded/balance invariant without runner retries or complete redesign.
expectations: Identifies shared account/order dependence and that the seed test proves only fixture mutation.
Identifies unjoined background work/errors and an assertion that can pass before refund executes.
Requires fresh persisted balance credit observation together with refunded state after completed operation, preserving the useful isolated flag test.
Rejects runner retries as repair, labels conclusions static, and does not execute/edit/delegate or take over case planning.
